title: Nordic Spirit Icy Peppermint Max Nicotine Pouches
description: Nordic Spirit Icy Peppermint Max Nicotine Pouches deliver a profoundly refreshing and bold mint profile. Designed for users who require a substantial and immediate sensation, this flavour provides a clean Peppermint burst that is intensely cooling and refreshing. Utilizing an updated moist formulation, these slim pouches ensure a rapid release of both flavour and nicotine compared to traditional dry options. This provides an efficient, fast-acting experience from the moment it is placed under the lip. Housed in a redesigned, slimmer can for a premium hand feel, these pouches offer maximum portability. Delivering a Max 17mg nicotine content, they provide a reliable, smoke-free experience with absolute discretion. How to Use: Place one Nordic Spirit pouch under your upper lip and allow the nicotine to release over time for a steady, satisfying experience. The pouch is designed to dissolve slowly for up to 40 minutes, providing an effective nicotine release without smoke or odour. Dispose of the pouch responsibly after use. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
